=== README.md ===
# hermes-context sync

One-way host -> workspace mirror of the hermes context tree.

- SRC (default): `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/`
- DST (default): `/workspace/hermes-context/`
- Log: `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log` (always outside DST)

## Install

1. Copy the script outside the mirrored tree:
   ```
   cp sync-hermes-context.sh ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
   chmod +x ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
   ```
2. Install user units:
   ```
   mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
   cp hermes-context.service hermes-context.timer ~/.config/systemd/user/
   systemctl --user daemon-reload
   systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer
   ```

The script also runs standalone (e.g. from cron) with no systemd dependency.

## Source/destination override (A17)

Env overrides are the mandated contract mechanism:
```
HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC=/path/to/src HERMES_CONTEXT_DST=/path/to/dst \
  ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
```

## Dry-run test (A6/A16)

```
~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run
```
Emits the plan to stdout only. Zero writes anywhere: no log entry, no stage dir,
no DST creation. If DST does not exist, it stays absent. Verify DST is
byte-identical (or still nonexistent) after the dry run.

## Sync strategy (A5/A7)

- Primary: `rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no SRC/ stage/` — contents of SRC
  staged (no nesting), stale entries deleted.
- Fallback (no rsync): tar-pipe `tar -C SRC -cf - . | tar -C stage -xf -`,
  then recursive reconciliation via a prunelist deletes stale entries at all
  depths.

Both paths converge identically to an exact recursive mirror: contents,
recursive directory structure, and symlinks (MIRROR class; metadata/timestamps
out of scope). The staged copy is content-verified against SRC (files, dirs,
symlink targets, no stale entries) before DST is touched. Only after a
verified copy exists is DST replaced. Verification failure exits nonzero and
leaves DST untouched — an unverified copy is never used or called "verified".

## Guards

Refusals exit nonzero, cite the governing law (A12/A14/A15/A18), and perform
zero writes: degenerate paths (`/`, empty, `.`), SRC==DST by realpath,
ancestor/descendant relationships, DST symlink resolving outside SRC, and any
owned path (log dir, stage, entrypoint dir) colliding with DST/SRC boundaries.
DST is never removed before a verified copy of SRC exists elsewhere.

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS

- Exotic filenames (newline/control characters) — A21.
- Adversarial env combinations beyond the A14 guard (e.g. pointing TMPDIR at
  DST/SRC in unusual ways) — A14.

Return corrected sections (same format: === <filename> ===), fixing every gate failure — a stated contract applies to ALL instances (if SRC is renamed, DST and every unit/README reference rename together, never just the cited one).

# ---------- guards (BEFORE any write; A19: refusals cite A-numbers) ----------

# A18: degenerate paths (component tests, not slash-suffix strings)
degenerate() {
  local p="$1"
  local rp; rp=$(realpath -m "$p" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
  [ -z "$p" ] && return 0
  [ "$p" = "." ] && return 0
  [ "$rp" = "/" ] && return 0
  return 1
}
degenerate "$SRC" && refuse "A18" "SRC is degenerate (/, empty, or .)"
degenerate "$DST" && refuse "A18" "DST is degenerate (/, empty, or .)"

# A12: realpath identity / ancestor / descendant / DST-inside-SRC
SRC_R=$(realpath "$SRC" 2>/dev/null) || SRC_R=$(realpath -m "$SRC")
DST_R=$(realpath "$DST" 2>/dev/null) || DST_R=$(realpath -m "$DST")

[ "$SRC_R" = "$DST_R" ] && refuse "A12" "realpath(SRC) == realpath(DST)"
inside_or_equal "$DST_R" "$SRC_R" && refuse "A12" "DST is inside-or-equal SRC (ancestor/descendant)"
inside_or_equal "$SRC_R" "$DST_R" && refuse "A12" "SRC is inside-or-equal DST (ancestor/descendant)"

# A18: DST symlink resolving outside SRC -> refuse (will be replaced with real tree on real run)
if [ -L "$DST" ]; then
  DST_T=$(readlink -f "$DST")
  case "$DST_T" in
    "$SRC_R"|"$SRC_R"/*) : ;;  # symlink into SRC is identity-class, refuse via A12
    *) refuse "A18" "DST is a symlink resolving outside SRC ($DST_T)" ;;
  esac
  refuse "A12" "DST symlink resolves into SRC"
fi

# A14/A15: compute owned concrete paths PURELY by string computation (A20: no mktemp/mkdir/write yet)
STAGE_BASE="${HOME}/.cache/hermes-context"
STAGE_PATH="${STAGE_BASE}/.hc-stage"   # real stage dir created later via mktemp under this parent

# log FILE's resolved parent (A15: concrete instantiated path, not generic ancestor)
LOG_PARENT=$(realpath -m "$LOG_DIR")

# entrypoint dir (concrete)
if [ -n "$ENTRYPOINT_DIR" ]; then
  EP_R=$(realpath "$ENTRYPOINT_DIR" 2>/dev/null) || EP_R="$ENTRYPOINT_DIR"
else
  EP_R=""
fi

for owned in "$LOG_PARENT" "$STAGE_BASE" $([ -n "$EP_R" ] && echo "$EP_R"); do
  [ -z "$owned" ] && continue
  [ "$owned" = "$DST_R" ] && refuse "A14" "owned path $owned collides with DST"
  inside_or_equal "$owned" "$DST_R" && refuse "A14" "owned path $owned is inside DST"
  inside_or_equal "$DST_R" "$owned" && refuse "A14" "DST is inside owned path $owned"
  [ "$owned" = "$SRC_R" ] && refuse "A14" "owned path $owned collides with SRC"
  inside_or_equal "$owned" "$SRC_R" && refuse "A14" "owned path $owned is inside SRC"
  inside_or_equal "$SRC_R" "$owned" && refuse "A14" "SRC is inside owned path $owned"
done

inside_or_equal "$STAGE_PATH" "$DST_R" && refuse "A14" "stage path is inside DST"
inside_or_equal "$STAGE_PATH" "$SRC_R" && refuse "A14" "stage path is inside SRC"

# ---------- dry-run (A6/A16): stdout plan only, ZERO side effects ----------
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
  echo "dry-run plan (no writes performed):"
  echo "  SRC: $SRC_R"
  echo "  DST: $DST_R"
  echo "  log: $LOG_FILE (not written in dry-run)"
  echo "  stage parent: $STAGE_BASE (not created in dry-run)"
  if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "  strategy: rsync -a --delete (primary), staged then content-verified, then DST replaced"
  else
    echo "  strategy: tar-pipe fallback + recursive prunelist reconcile, staged then content-verified, then DST replaced"
  fi
  echo "  stale entries deleted at all depths (A5/A7)"
  exit 0
fi

# ---------- real run ----------
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || refuse "A14" "cannot create log dir $LOG_DIR"

log() {
  echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') $*" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# A20: create stage AFTER guards; script-owned mktemp under STAGE_BASE (never TMPDIR root)
mkdir -p "$STAGE_BASE" || { log "FAIL: cannot create stage base $STAGE_BASE"; echo "refused: A14: cannot create stage base" >&2; exit 1; }
STAGE=$(mktemp -d "${STAGE_BASE}/.hc-stage.XXXXXX") || { log "FAIL: mktemp stage failed"; exit 1; }

cleanup() {
  [ -n "${STAGE:-}" ] && [ -d "$STAGE" ] && rm -rf "$STAGE"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# 1e: stage copy (contents of SRC into stage, no nesting)
if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATEGY=rsync
  rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no "$SRC_R/" "$STAGE/" || { log "FAIL: rsync staging failed"; echo "FAIL: rsync staging failed" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  STRATEGY=tar
  tar -C "$SRC_R" -cf - . | tar -C "$STAGE" -xf - || { log "FAIL: tar staging failed"; echo "FAIL: tar staging failed" >&2; exit 1; }

  PRUNELIST=$(mktemp "${STAGE_BASE}/.prunelist.XXXXXX") || { log "FAIL: mktemp prunelist failed"; exit 1; }

  ( cd "$STAGE" && find . -mindepth 1 -name '.prunelist.*' -prune -o -print ) > "${PRUNELIST}.walk" || { log "FAIL: find walk failed"; exit 1; }
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    rel="${rel#./}"
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    if [ ! -e "$SRC_R/$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$SRC_R/$rel" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$rel" >> "$PRUNELIST"
    fi
  done < "${PRUNELIST}.walk"
  rm -f "${PRUNELIST}.walk"
  if [ -s "$PRUNELIST" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      rm -rf -- "${STAGE:?}/${rel}"
    done < "$PRUNELIST"
  fi
  rm -f "$PRUNELIST"
fi

# 1f: content-verify stage vs SRC (A9/A13): files, dirs, symlinks (targets), recursive
# Status propagated via a script-owned status file (A20 reserved namespace) because
# pipeline subshells cannot mutate caller variables.
VF="${STAGE}/.verify-status"
: > "$VF"
verify_walk() {
  local src_root="$1" stage_root="$2"
  local rel
  # every SRC entry must exist in stage with same type/content
  ( cd "$src_root" && find . -mindepth 1 -print ) | while IFS= read -r rel; do
    rel="${rel#./}"
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    s="$src_root/$rel"
    d="$stage_root/$rel"
    if [ -L "$s" ]; then
      [ -L "$d" ] || { echo "missing symlink: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
      [ "$(readlink "$s")" = "$(readlink "$d")" ] || { echo "symlink target mismatch: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
    elif [ -d "$s" ]; then
      [ -d "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || { echo "missing dir: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
    elif [ -f "$s" ]; then
      [ -f "$d" ] && [ ! -L "$d" ] || { echo "missing file: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
      cmp -s "$s" "$d" || { echo "content mismatch: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
    fi
  done
  # A5: no extra entries in stage (stale deleted)
  ( cd "$stage_root" && find . -mindepth 1 -name '.verify-status' -prune -o -print ) | while IFS= read -r rel; do
    rel="${rel#./}"
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    [ -e "$src_root/$rel" ] || [ -L "$src_root/$rel" ] || { echo "stale in stage: $rel" >&2; echo 1 > "$VF"; exit 1; }
  done
  return 0
}
verify_walk "$SRC_R" "$STAGE"
if [ -s "$VF" ]; then
  rm -f "$VF"
  log "FAIL: staging verification failed (strategy=$STRATEGY); DST untouched"
  echo "FAIL: staging verification failed (A9/A13); DST untouched" >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$VF"
log "staging verified (strategy=$STRATEGY): VERIFIED_COPY of SRC exists"

# 1g: only after VERIFIED_COPY (A11): replace DST
# Remove DST entirely (guard ensured DST != SRC and DST not ancestor of SRC),
# then mv the verified stage into place — never mv stage ONTO an existing dir
# (mv into an existing dir would nest stage as DST/.hc-stage.XXXX -> content mismatch).
if [ -L "$DST" ]; then
  rm -f "$DST"   # A18: replace symlink with real tree
fi
if [ -d "$DST" ]; then
  find "$DST" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} + || { log "FAIL: clearing DST failed"; exit 1; }
  rmdir "$DST" || { log "FAIL: rmdir DST failed"; exit 1; }
fi
if mv "$STAGE" "$DST" 2>/dev/null; then
  STAGE=""   # consumed by mv
else
  # cross-fs fallback: recreate DST and rsync verified stage into it
  mkdir -p "$DST" || { log "FAIL: cannot create DST $DST"; exit 1; }
  rsync -a --copy-links=no "$STAGE/" "$DST/" || { log "FAIL: cross-fs copy into DST failed"; exit 1; }
  rm -rf "$STAGE"
  STAGE=""
fi
trap - EXIT

log "OK: DST mirrored from SRC (strategy=$STRATEGY), stale deleted at all depths"
exit 0

=== README.md ===
# hermes-context sync

One-way host -> workspace mirror of the hermes context tree.

- SRC (default): `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/`
- DST (default): `/workspace/hermes-context/`
- Log: `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log` (always outside DST)

## Install

1. Copy the script outside the mirrored tree:
   ```
   cp sync-hermes-context.sh ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
   chmod +x ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
   ```
2. Install user units:
   ```
   mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
   cp hermes-context.service hermes-context.timer ~/.config/systemd/user/
   systemctl --user daemon-reload
   systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer
   ```

The script also runs standalone (e.g. from cron) with no systemd dependency.

## Source/destination override (A17)

Env overrides are the mandated contract mechanism:
```
HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC=/path/to/src HERMES_CONTEXT_DST=/path/to/dst \
  ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
```

## Dry-run test (A6/A16)

```
~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run
```
Emits the plan to stdout only. Zero writes anywhere: no log entry, no stage dir,
no DST creation. If DST does not exist, it stays absent. Verify DST is
byte-identical (or still nonexistent) after the dry run.

## Sync strategy (A5/A7)

- Primary: `rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no SRC/ stage/` — contents of SRC
  staged (no nesting), stale entries deleted.
- Fallback (no rsync): tar-pipe `tar -C SRC -cf - . | tar -C stage -xf -`,
  then recursive reconciliation via a prunelist deletes stale entries at all
  depths.

Both paths converge identically to an exact recursive mirror: contents,
recursive directory structure, and symlinks (MIRROR class; metadata/timestamps
out of scope). The staged copy is content-verified against SRC (files, dirs,
symlink targets, no stale entries) before DST is touched. Only after a
verified copy exists is DST replaced: the existing DST tree is removed and the
verified stage is moved into place (cross-fs fallback: rsync stage into
recreated DST). Verification failure exits nonzero and leaves DST untouched —
an unverified copy is never used or called "verified".

## Guards

Refusals exit nonzero, cite the governing law (A12/A14/A15/A18), and perform
zero writes: degenerate paths (`/`, empty, `.`), SRC==DST by realpath,
ancestor/descendant relationships, DST symlink resolving outside SRC, and any
owned path (log dir, stage, entrypoint dir) colliding with DST/SRC boundaries.
DST is never removed before a verified copy of SRC exists elsewhere.

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS

- Exotic filenames (newline/control characters) — A21.
- Adversarial env combinations beyond the A14 guard (e.g. pointing TMPDIR at
  DST/SRC in unusual ways) — A14.
